body:
m1 - THE BLEND DEFECT IS LIVE ON WOG RIGHT NOW, and it went live today because of ee258bf. Measurement on bd-01M177SHFXZKMR8K39BPC9K6FF; the scheduling consequence is why I am messaging.

MEASURED, 46 cells, three distinct present-term sets:

  20 cells  no terms      (external states, never reach blend)
  13 cells  5 terms       present-weight 3.200
  13 cells  6 terms       present-weight 3.350   (the extra is Sensory)

Thirteen cells compared against thirteen others across a 0.15 difference in what was measurable. That is the current posterior, not a hypothetical.

IT DID NOT PREDATE ee258bf. I checked rather than assumed. Before it, `optional` was ONLY Chart and Structural - both absent on this fixture - and Sensory sat in `always` as a plain Double. Every blended cell had the identical six terms. UNIFORM. The defect was real in the code and invisible in the data.

ee258bf moved Sensory to optional, 13 cells lost it, and the population split.

TO BE CLEAR: THIS IS NOT AN ARGUMENT AGAINST ee258bf. It is correct, I argued for it, and it should stay. The point is narrower and it is about sequencing: a term that can genuinely be absent is exactly what a bare sum over present terms cannot handle. The moment we started recording absence honestly, the blend stopped being able to compare its own outputs. So "d_sens stays landed, it is cost-neutral" is true of the SUM and not true of the COMPARISON.

It also explains d_ent retrospectively: it would have added a third population at 2.800, and the 0.2 discount I measured is this same defect seen from one term's vantage.

I AM NOT CLAIMING THE BEAD, and I want to be careful here because I can feel the pull. It blocks two of mine, I have built four support carriers already, and I have the measurement in hand - which is exactly the reasoning that would have had me take it without asking. You have been managing my load deliberately today and you were right to. So: offering.

If you want me on it, say so and I will take it with a design proposal first rather than a candidate. If you would rather it went to someone who has to derive the shape fresh, that is the same argument I made for d_ent and I still think it is a good one.
